g.text: Sequence: a VIP arrives, the manager switches Happy Hour on, and the VIP pays $10.80 instead of $13.50 (stage-3, base arrival turn 4)
Manager choice 1: Happy Hour (the choice that changes the outcome)
[no staff member has acted yet this turn]
guards: enabled and not yet used,
ok("Happy Hour is ON for this turn
[a staff member already acted this turn]
fail("only at the start of a turn")
Steps 2-3: Host, Waiter and Chef assignments (Host, then Waiter, then Chef)
[until the ActionResult is a success (an invalid choice does not use up the task)]
#2 has no order waiting to be
The Waiter's task was not consumed (markActed() is only reached after success),
so the same turn continues. Before the Host acts, a Waiter choice is rejected by the controller's phase check.
The bill is locked now: status PLACED,
ok("... The dish is READY (it can be
served next turn at the earliest).")
[for each customer still in the restaurant]
How the manager's choice changed the outcome
If the manager answers 0 to the Happy Hour question (no Happy Hour), the VIP orders the same Burger but the bill is locked at $13.50
(satisfaction 95 at payment, not 100), so revenue is $2.70 lower. Choosing Happy Hour at the right moment lifted
the VIP to 100 and discounted the order, a trade-off between income per customer and satisfaction.
